theme.name: Lumina
theme.description: Warm white and deep blue palette maximizing readability and accessibility. Ideal for audiences that prioritize clarity and content consumption.

designLenses.nielsensHeuristics: Maximum readability through high contrast text and clear visual hierarchy — matches the 'match between system and real world' heuristic
designLenses.wcagPour: All color combinations meet WCAG AAA contrast ratios (7:1+ for body text, 4.5:1+ for large text) — Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust
